name: How do I care for and maintain my new kitchen flooring?

mainEntity.name: How do I care for and maintain my new kitchen flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Caring for your new kitchen flooring depends on the material. For most floors like LVP, laminate, and tile, regular sweeping or vacuuming to remove debris is essential. Mop with a damp cloth or a manufacturer-recommended cleaner, avoiding excessive water. For hardwood or engineered wood, use specialized wood floor cleaners and avoid harsh chemicals or steam mops. Always wipe up spills immediately to prevent damage. Using mats in high-spill areas and furniture pads can also help prolong your floor's life.
acceptedAnswer.description: Care for new kitchen flooring by regular sweeping, using appropriate cleaners for the material, and promptly cleaning spills.
